svg.title: Brechatsnech Belt Survey Vessel - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 106-107, PDF 107-108. Interpreted combined three-deck envelope uses largest Deck 1 with flat chamfered forward end, broad bulbous aft survey body and twin drives. Smaller cargo/drone decks fit inside its maximum envelope; relative longitudinal alignment is simplified. Illustration corroborates broad aft body and narrow forward superstructure. Interior bay openings do not create hull holes.
